As soon as I got away from the door a pair of rich looking middle aged women appeared from around the corner.
Rich woman in a pink jacket: I still can’t get over the whole Patrick situation.
Rich woman with overly huge boobs: I know right! “Shopping in the slums, because it’s cheaper and the quality is the same” Hahahahahaha! Get real.
Rich woman in a pink jacket: To be honest with you. I suspect something worse…
Rich woman with overly huge boobs: …
Rich woman in a pink jacket: He… He might be poor!
Rich woman with overly huge boobs: *gasp*
Rich woman with overly huge boobs: No way? You think he can’t afford the 1 mil membership fee? That’s… EWWWWWWWWWWWWWW!?!
Rich woman in a pink jacket: No, no, no, no~, NOOO! I don’t even want to think about it!
And they entered the shop that I’ve been struggling to enter.
1 million $ membership fee?!
What the fuck?
Let’s get out of here.
